name_zh: 巴勒斯坦起义/国际法：少数派生存与国际法建国
name_en: Palestinian Intifada/International Law: Minority Survival & International Law Nation-Building
description_zh: 巴勒斯坦亚西尔·阿拉法特 (1929-2004) 法塔赫/巴解组织/1964 成立/1987 第一次起义/1993 奥斯陆协议/巴勒斯坦权力机构/2000 第二次起义/马哈茂德·阿巴斯/加沙/约旦河西岸/耶路撒冷/定居点/难民/回归权/国际法/联合国/观察员国/国际刑事法院/比勒费尔德/建国/抵抗/外交/团结。核心建国逻辑：抵抗合法性(武装/民众/外交)→国际法框架(决议/法院/条约/观察员)→建国机构(权力机构/立法/司法/安全部队)→团结外交(阿拉伯/伊斯兰/不结盟/全球南方/比勒费尔德)。体现 M172 少数派生存与国际法建国 — 以"抵抗合法性+国际法框架+建国机构+团结外交"四位一体，在占领/定居点/分裂/大国四重重压下追求巴勒斯坦主权国家。
description_en: Palestinian Yasser Arafat (1929-2004) Fatah/PLO/1964 founded/1987 First Intifada/1993 Oslo Accords/PA/2000 Second Intifada/Mahmoud Abbas/Gaza/West Bank/Jerusalem/settlements/refugees/right of return/international law/UN/observer state/ICC/Bielefeld/statehood/resistance/diplomacy/solidarity. Core nation-building logic: resistance legitimacy (armed/popular/diplomatic) -> international law framework (resolutions/courts/treaties/observer) -> state-building institutions (PA/legislative/judicial/security) -> solidarity diplomacy (Arab/Islamic/Non-Aligned/Global South/Bielefeld). Exemplifies M172 Minority Survival & International Law Nation-Building — quaternity of 'resistance legitimacy + international law framework + state-building institutions + solidarity diplomacy' pursuing Palestinian sovereign state amid quadruple pressures of occupation/settlements/division/great powers.
reason_zh: 巴勒斯坦非单纯抵抗运动，而是"抵抗+国际法+建国+团结"四位一体建国实验。起义提供合法性，国际法提供框架(194/242/338/2334/观察员/ICC)，权力机构提供雏形，团结外交提供支撑。M172 区隔于 M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)、M202 抵抗建国(东帝汶)、M216 少数族裔自决(斯里兰卡)，核心在于"抵抗即建国动力+国际法即建国框架+团结即外交资源"的巴勒斯坦建国范式。
reason_en: Palestine not mere resistance movement but 'resistance + international law + state-building + solidarity' quaternity nation-building experiment. Intifada provides legitimacy, international law provides framework (194/242/338/2334/observer/ICC), PA provides embryo, solidarity diplomacy provides support. M172 distinct from M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage), M202 Resistance Nation-Building (Timor-Leste), M216 Minority Self-Determination (Sri Lanka), core: 'resistance as nation-building drive + international law as nation-building framework + solidarity as diplomatic resource' Palestinian nation-building paradigm.
